messages:
Ines: Quick follow-up from today's RFC review — we need a small ops plan for retrofitting sampled traces with late-enrich attributes so billing matches queries.
Sam: Agree. Current issue: sampling happens at edge, enrichment later; queries that reconstruct traces don't see billing keys -> money mismatch.
Ryan: Can you post a concrete example of mismatch?
Ines: Yeah — user reported 20% of inference-cache traces show 'unknown_tenant' in billing UI even though later join resolves tenant.
Ines: Short log snippet:
```
edge: sample id=abc123 tenant=null
enrich: sample id=abc123 tenant=acme
query: join sample abc123 -> tenant=null
```
Maria: Oof. So lineage is lost because sampler drops attributes, not id. Do we have sample ids preserved everywhere?
Ines: We preserve sample id in 90% of paths but two legacy collectors drop it (mobile collector v1, internal ingestion proxy). Those are the pain points.
Sam: Options:
- Backfill: replay stored payloads to recompute billing keys (heavy)
- Rehydrate at query-time: join late attributes from enrichment store (may be slow)
- Preventive: update collectors to keep sample id + minimal attrs (best long term)
Ryan: For short-term, rehydrate at query-time + mark as 'eventual' in billing seems reasonable.
Maria: For quota/cost alerts we need immediate correctness. Can we do a lightweight partial backfill for high-traffic tenants only?
Ines: Yes. Proposal: 1) quick backfill for top-20 tenants over last 30d, 2) query-time rehydrate fallback for everything else, 3) collector patch rollout to preserve sample id (mobile v1 -> v2 only).
Sam: I'm worried about query latency hits from rehydrate joins. Can we cache rehydrated keys in a small memstore keyed by sample id with TTL 24h?
Ines: Yes — caching plan included. Also will add a flag on samples: billing_resolved = true/false so UI shows 'pending' for unresolved.
ingest-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://go/repo/tasks/retrofit-sample-reconciliation (task #3217)
Maria: I'll own the backfill job (estimate 6h). Ryan can own the query-side cache and TTL design.
Ryan: On it. I'll sketch a small LRU with async refresh.
Sam: I'll coordinate collector patches + rollout schedule.
Ines: Perfect. I'll update the RFC with this ops plan and timeline. Thanks :thumbsup:
